jacquard_studio.name: Cards become cloth — loom and layers
jacquard_studio.description: Choose stripes, checks, tartan, chevron, herringbone, houndstooth or optical checks with seven physical buttons. Each starts a fresh 96-pick sample. Open its actual yarn geometry with LAYERS or the slider; FLAT closes the same cloth. Clear and run to watch the laced punch-card chain weave the chosen sample one pass at a time. Card lifts and warp/weft colour periods are independent. Edit cards or colours to change future picks while preserving earlier cloth. Dense 96-warp cloth, up to 128 actual picks, with a linked top-thread drawdown. Optical checks use graduated burgundy/cream colour bands in 2/2 twill; the cloth remains flat until deliberately opened. Longer colour sequences have paged controls.

jacquard_weaver.name: Twelve-hook Jacquard loom
jacquard_weaver.description: Eight editable, pickable cards hang in a laced loop and drive a twelve-hook geometric loom. ONE PICK seats a card, lifts hooks and draws the weft before committing one record. Warp and weft colours repeat independently of the lift program. TARTAN + CLEAR starts a fresh authored 2/2 twill. Colour and card edits preserve earlier picks. Dense 96-thread cloth, up to 128 actual picks. Use jacquard_studio for the seven sample buttons and linked layer inspection table.

weave_layers.name: A pick becomes a layer
weave_layers.description: Inspect supplied loom records as dense coloured yarn. The grabbable slider and FLAT/LAYERS buttons reversibly open the same mesh without changing its history. A flat drawdown shows each upper thread colour. Starts empty without a record. The paired jacquard_studio connects seven sample buttons: stripes, checks, tartan, chevron, herringbone, houndstooth and optical checks. Up to 128 recorded picks across 96 warp threads.
